text: This may be a silly one so apologies. I have my grandson (4) staying over. He's running 38.3 tonight. He just won't settle off to sleep, keeps popping out of bed, but apart from that he's his usual self. His eczema is flaring as well, dry itchy patches on his tummy and legs and he's scratching. Probably fussing over nothing but thought I'd better check what you'd suggest rather than lie awake wondering.
